assertions: The pinned Personal Knowledge implementation returns bounded projections with source references.
The pinned Pet Assistant treats projections as untrusted data and independently gates delegation.
Only exact-action, exact-scope, active, non-stale and sufficiently authoritative claims bind fields.
Explicit-only fields, conflicting memory, stale memory and inferred memory remain unresolved.
Every memory binding retains claim and provenance references.
The result never authorizes or executes the action.
